parsed.rationale: This is a regular sinus rhythm at about 75 bpm with narrow QRS complexes and a normal PR interval. R-wave progression is normal and voltages are well below LVH criteria. There is no pathological Q wave, and the minimal J-point elevation in V2–V3 with upright T waves is a normal variant, so there is no STEMI.
